# About this directory

**These guides are generated. Do not edit them here — your change will be overwritten.**

Every `.md` file in this directory is mirrored automatically from the Daakia CallKit Android SDK
repository whenever its docs change, so that a change to the SDK and the documentation of that
change ship together and cannot drift apart.

## Found a problem in the docs?

[Open an issue](https://github.com/Daakia-Org/daakia-callkit-android-support/issues/new/choose) —
that is the right channel, and it reaches the people who can fix it at the source. A pull request
against these files cannot be merged, because the next mirror would revert it.

## What is not generated

- `index.html` — this repository's docs landing page.
- `README.md` — this file.
- The repository `README.md` and everything outside `docs/`.

These are maintained here by hand.
